data.content: Arsenal heads to League Two side Fleetwood Town on Tuesday for a Carabao Cup fourth-round tie at Highbury Stadium. Goals from Ezri Konsa and Gabriel earned them a 2-0 win over Everton on Saturday. Mikel Arteta is still without Bukayo Saka and William Saliba, while Riccardo Calafiori and Christos Tzolis are both doubts for the trip. Here is how Arsenal will line up against Fleetwood Town:. Max Dowman, who scored twice against Ipswich Town in the last round, gets the start, while 18-year-old Ceadach O'Neill will get his first start for the Gunners. ## Will Bukayo Saka play vs. He also sat out the win over Everton, and reports suggest he could be sidelined for several weeks.
